---
title: Page templates
description: Seven full-page templates — dashboard, portfolio, e-commerce, supply-chain, blog, admin settings, landing.
---

`tekivex-ui` includes seven complete page templates. Each is responsive
across mobile / tablet / desktop, uses real components throughout, and is
copyable verbatim.

| Template | Purpose |
|---|---|
| **Dashboard** | Analytics with charts, KPI cards, activity feed |
| **Portfolio** | Personal or agency showcase |
| **E-commerce** | Product catalogue + cart + reviews |
| **Supply chain** | Logistics, warehouse, supplier tables |
| **Blog / CMS** | Article listing, reading, sidebar, pagination |
| **Admin settings** | Tabbed configuration panels with forms |
| **Landing page** | Marketing — hero, features, pricing, FAQ, CTA |

The templates currently live in the interactive demo
(`https://ui.tekivex.com/#/templates/<name>`); MDX migration with full
source listings ships in a follow-up.
